fields.name: original_ratio
fields.label: Keep original image proportions
fields.instructions: Off: images fill matching 8:5 frames, as in the design. On: the full image is displayed without cropping.

fields.name: images
fields.label: Images
fields.instructions: One image fills the full width. Two or more images form a two-column gallery. Captions appear below each image. On mobile the gallery stacks into one column.

sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.label: Image
sub_fields.instructions: Choose from the Media Library. Alternative text is taken from the selected media item.

sub_fields.name: caption
sub_fields.label: Caption
sub_fields.instructions: Optional text below this image. Leave empty to hide the caption.
